title: NIST WebBook: Caffeine is C8H10N4O2, molecular weight 194.1906 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Caffeine as C8H10N4O2, molecular weight 194.1906 amu, CAS 58-08-2.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Caffeine, CAS Registry Number 58-08-2, lists molecular formula C8H10N4O2 and molecular weight 194.1906 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 194.0803756 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C8H10N4O2/c1-10-4-9-6-5(10)7(13)12(3)8(14)11(6)2/h4H,1-3H3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
